name: em-code-advisor
description: Assign the correct E/M (Evaluation and Management) code from a clinical note and justify it element by element against the 2021/2023 CPT MDM grid and time thresholds, across office/outpatient, hospital inpatient/observation, emergency department, nursing facility, and home/residence settings. Codes the documentation rather than the encounter, binds every code and minute threshold to bundled reference tables instead of recalling them, refuses to invent a code or report a confidence percentage, and returns documentation gaps as provider queries rather than guesses.
